title: Song assignment
description: One ready song assignment for one track_id. Budget figures are this assignment's limits, not hidden product defaults. No market, promotion, distribution, or play-count fields.

assignment.description: The ready song assignment. Downstream steps write and check lyrics and design sound from this text.

package_review_required.description: Optional human gate before the first generation. Default for the pilot is on.

reference_use_permitted.description: True only when use of a voice or reference is explicitly permitted. Lack of permission is not permission.

budget.description: Configurable limits. Reaching a limit pauses the track for a human decision. A network retry is not a new creative attempt.
